items.label: Innovative Design
items.value: Integrating the headphone/headset and controller into a single assembly, allowing for both combined and separate use

items.label: Wide Compatibility
items.value: Fits all sizes of earphones from various brands.Compatible with PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and more gaming controllers

items.label: Premium Material
items.value: Crafted from premium solid black walnut wood, featuring natural grain patterns for aesthetic appeal.Hand-sanded surface treated with food-grade wood wax oil, ensuring odorless, non-toxic coating that preserves wood's authentic texture

items.label: Extra storage space
items.value: The bottom features a dedicated storage space for your device chargers, gaming accessories, remote controls, scissors, pens, and power banks. Keep frequently used devices and items within easy reach

items.label: Gaming Gift Idea & Gift Box
items.value: Organize & style your gaming space effortlessly. Perfect for gaming enthusiasts (husbands, friends, teens) – ideal for birthdays, holidays, or anytime

items.value: ps5 controller, switch controller, xbox controller
